title: aider_shim's door proof asks inference_domain over the bus
intention: aider_shim's door proof measures inference_domain's models view only over the bus, through cairn.tools.bus_client, and imports nothing from inference_domain.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: inspector.encapsulation_breaches lists 2 rows with source cairn/devices/aider_shim — test_no_direct_reach.py:179 and :194 import cairn.devices.inference_domain.device to construct the provider and call its get verb in-process. RULE 1: a device's interface is the bus, reached through bus_client.
traces_to: RULE 1 (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md) and parent 8e3474a6ae43; Law 4 (encapsulation_holds is the physics).
how: Swap the two in-process view teeth for one tooth that asks get/what=models over bus_client.inference_bus(); red-first proof modelled on 7bc784d5a7de's reach-no-device proof.
falsifier: (1) encapsulation_breaches lists no row whose source is cairn/devices/aider_shim; (2) test_no_direct_reach.py imports nothing from cairn.devices.inference_domain, carries test_inference_domain_answers_the_models_view_over_the_bus, and runs green. Green twice.

decisions.text: Red-first proof cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_aider_shim_proofs_reach_no_device.py, copying the shape of cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_db_domain_proofs_reach_no_device.py. PROVES = {'ea19fc079c0b': {'1': 'test_no_aider_shim_row', '2': 'test_the_door_proof_asks_over_the_bus'}}. Tooth 1: no row of inspector.encapsulation_breaches(repo) has source 'cairn/devices/aider_shim'. Tooth 2: ast-parse cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py; no Import/ImportFrom whose module is cairn.devices.inference_domain or starts with it plus a dot (the file's FORBIDDEN_MODULE string constant is allowed — it is the instrument, not a reach); a function named test_inference_domain_answers_the_models_view_over_the_bus exists and the composite test_aider_shim_reaches_inference_domain_only_through_a_door calls it; then run cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py as a subprocess (sys.executable, cwd repo, PYTHONPATH repo, timeout 600) and require exit 0.

In cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py: delete test_inference_domain_declares_a_models_view_that_returns_the_stack and test_the_seam_answers_the_same_stack_as_the_view. Add test_inference_domain_answers_the_models_view_over_the_bus: import inference_bus and models_stack from cairn.tools.bus_client inside the tooth; reply = inference_bus().request(sender='aider_shim', to='inference_domain', verb='get', why='aider_shim proof: the models view, asked of its owner over the bus', body={'what': 'models'}); body = reply['body']; assert body['accepted'] is True and body['view'] == 'models'; names = {m['name'] for m in body['data']['models']}; assert 'qwen3-coder:30b' in names; assert models_stack() == body['data']. In the composite declared tooth, replace the two removed calls with one call to the new tooth. Update the module docstring's door sentence to say the owner's view is asked over the bus. PROVES unchanged.

Run the red-first proof, then after the build run both proofs twice, serially, PYTHONPATH=. python3 <path>. Commit before the hollow reading. Seal each with bin/cairn test --seal <path> (cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py reseals for 50ad391f4e95 under its unchanged PROVES). Live measure: encapsulation_breaches row count before (86) and after (84), recorded in the verdict.
